title: I just switched from Cursor to Claude Code and wish I did it earlier
author: DifferenceSerious395

comments.author: lovable-fried-donut
comments.body: Claude has gotten so far ahead of the other LLMs for code (at least in my experience), that the price to value for a Max plan beats Cursor hands down.

replies.author: DifferenceSerious395
replies.body:
100%.

Also FYI I just managed to claim about USD$50 worth of free extra usage credits on the usage page: [https://claude.ai/settings/usage](https://claude.ai/settings/usage)

Not sure if everyone gets it but check in case.
